acceptance.explanation: All seven blue samples improve: the summed color and saturation error falls by 32.3%. The grade changes only the young population, preserving photopic brightness at every pixel; geometry, dust, resolved points and all other materials are identical. The component saturation is 1.480, with R/G and B/G tint factors 0.975 and 0.874; this acts on the already blue young spectrum. The photo is sampled over the bluest eligible light in each 31 by 31 crop to exclude white and pink clusters. Earlier-pin color changes stay within the declared 0.035 log-ratio tolerance. Side views remain coherent. The result is visibly bluer but does not yet reproduce the photo’s deep blue: foreground old light and the fixed global saturation dilute this component. No local color field or brightness adjustment was introduced.

independentReview.followUp: The final rendered PNG score is distinguished from the floating-point calibration score. grade.score again records appearanceLoss, with the pin objective stored separately. The hard 0.035 retention gate is enforced by finish.mts and gates.mts; its complete artifact check passes. The sampled neighborhoods fit within the native pixel mask.
